description: WHEN: the test cases of some touched objects should be grouped in one suite of an existing test plan, to replay them. Triggers: 'create the regression suite', 'suite de non-régression pour la PR N', 'group the tests of these objects'. Creates a query-based (dynamic) suite that gathers by itself every test case tagged obj:<object>. SAFE BY DEFAULT: confirm=false only shows the suite and how many cases it would gather now. Call again with confirm=true after the user agreed. A suite with the same name in the plan is reused. Needs a PAT with Test Management (Read & write) and the Basic + Test Plans access level.

confirm.description: false (default): preview only. true: create. Only after the user agreed.

name.description: Suite name. Default: 'Regression - ' and the first objects.

objects.description: Comma-separated D365 objects whose test cases the suite gathers.

planId.description: Id of the test plan that will hold the suite.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT.

name: ado_create_regression_suite
